# EMMana-Next rev28 — compare/tune workflow

- Added geometry Undo/Redo (30 steps) with toolbar buttons and Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+Y shortcuts outside form fields.
- Yagi quick edits, wire add/delete/feed assignment, endpoint drag, template replacement and optimizer apply participate in geometry history.
- Saved Design Variant snapshots now retain a compact S11 Sweep trace and exact EMNX project copy locally.
- The three most recent variants are presented chronologically as A/B/C.
- Added optional A/B/C S11 overlays on the current Sweep chart with per-variant toggles.
- Added concise B/C relative-to-A change summaries (Yagi dimensions + VSWR + Dmax + resonance + min S11).
- Added Open A/B/C to restore exact saved geometry; results are intentionally invalidated and must be recalculated.
- Solver physics, schemas, measurement contract and optimizer semantics are unchanged.
